title: Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. Selects EquipmentShare to Drive Next Era of Race Event Infrastructure
summary: Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. has selected EquipmentShare to deliver technology-enabled equipment and industry-leading fleet connectivity.
body_markdown:
**LAS VEGAS, NV – (October 15, 2026 —** Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. has selected EquipmentShare.com Inc (Nasdaq: EQPT) (“EquipmentShare”), a leader in connected jobsite technology and one of the largest construction equipment rental providers in the United States, to deliver technology-enabled equipment and industry-leading fleet connectivity driving the next chapter of site production for the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX. As the Las Vegas Grand Prix enters a new phase of operational scale, EquipmentShare will connect setup workflows, labor and machinery across the race footprint through its proprietary[T3®](https://t3.tech/) technology platform.


Under the agreement, EquipmentShare will deploy its T3-powered fleet and digital management solutions across the full lifecycle of the event. This includes managing equipment workflows from initial load-in across the permanent 39-acre Grand Prix Plaza site through real-time race execution and post-event teardown.


As an Official Supplier of the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX, EquipmentShare will integrate directly with event production teams to elevate standards of site safety, operational transparency, and fleet management.


"Setting the stage for race weekend in Las Vegas is one of the most complex temporary infrastructure projects in global sport," said Chris Garnett, VP Construction Operations of Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. "Reliability, safety and precision are paramount. Partnering with EquipmentShare ensures our operations are backed by leading technology and a team dedicated to flawless execution. Their connected jobsite solutions will allow us to build, run and maintain our site with increased efficiency."


Constructing a world-class temporary street circuit within the heart of global hospitality demands accuracy, speed and safety. Through T3’s real-time telematics and automated diagnostics, site managers gain detailed visibility into fleet health, helping operate equipment at optimal conditions to reduce unexpected downtime and keep the build on schedule. To safeguard the high-security footprint along the Las Vegas Strip, T3 also provides access control designed to restrict machine operation to authorized, certified personnel to help prevent unauthorized use, mitigate security risks and promote jobsite safety.


"Formula 1 represents the absolute pinnacle of engineering performance, and we are bringing that exact standard to the infrastructure supporting it," said Jabbok Schlacks, CEO and Founder of EquipmentShare. "Serving as the equipment supplier to operate this world-renowned event reflects the trust placed in our innovation, fleet reliability, and team. We look forward to helping to deliver an incredible race day and showing the world what a connected, tech-driven equipment solution can accomplish on the global stage."


**About FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX** Established in 2023, the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX is promoted by Formula 1®, in collaboration with Clark County. The 50-lap race takes place on a 3.8-mile circuit in the heart of the Las Vegas Strip and sees drivers reach jaw-dropping speeds of over 215 mph (346 kph) as they drive past some of the world's most iconic landmarks, hotels and casinos. Through the Las Vegas Grand Prix Foundation, Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. has donated more than $2 million to non-profit organizations working to strengthen the local community. The 2026 race will take place on November 19-21, 2026, with a recently announced extension confirming the event in Las Vegas through 2037. For more information, visit[www.f1lasvegasgp.com](http://www.f1lasvegasgp.com/) .


**About EquipmentShare**
Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Columbia, Missouri, EquipmentShare (Nasdaq: EQPT) is a nationwide construction technology and equipment solutions provider dedicated to transforming the construction industry through innovative tools, platforms and data-driven insights. By empowering contractors, builders and equipment owners with its proprietary technology, T3®, EquipmentShare aims to drive productivity, efficiency, and collaboration across the construction sector. With a comprehensive suite of solutions that includes a fleet management platform, telematics devices and a best-in-class equipment rental marketplace, EquipmentShare continues to lead the industry in building the future of construction. For more information, visit[www.equipmentshare.com](http://www.equipmentshare.com/) .
